pdd-main.name: PDD 白底主图
pdd-main.desc: 白底、居中、占比约 80%、无文字水印，符合平台主图规范
pdd-main.prompt_prefix: Professional e-commerce product photograph for an online marketplace listing. The product is centered and fills about 80% of the frame.
pdd-main.prompt_suffix: Pure clean seamless white background (RGB 255,255,255), no props, no background objects, no text, no logo, no watermark, no border. Bright even studio lighting with a very soft subtle shadow directly under the product. Ultra sharp focus, high resolution, realistic, color-accurate, retail-ready. Square 1:1 composition.

pdd-scene.name: PDD 场景图
pdd-scene.desc: 把产品放进真实生活场景，适合详情页/种草图
pdd-scene.prompt_prefix: Lifestyle e-commerce scene photo. Place the product naturally in a realistic, aspirational everyday setting that matches how it is used.
pdd-scene.prompt_suffix: Warm natural lighting, shallow depth of field, tasteful props that support (never distract from) the product, plenty of clean negative space, premium commercial photography look, no text, no watermark. Square 1:1 composition.

pdd-sellingpoint.name: PDD 卖点图
pdd-sellingpoint.desc: 产品 + 中文卖点文字标注；需用 --text 传入卖点
pdd-sellingpoint.prompt_prefix: E-commerce selling-point graphic featuring the product prominently on a clean, modern, well-organized layout.
pdd-sellingpoint.prompt_suffix: Overlay crisp, correctly-spelled Chinese marketing text as neat bullet points or labeled callout boxes near the corresponding features, using a bold modern sans-serif font with high contrast. Professional, tidy, no typos, no watermark. Square 1:1 composition.

pdd-detail.name: PDD 详情图
pdd-detail.desc: 竖向 2:3 详情图，带卖点留白
pdd-detail.prompt_suffix: Show the product with key feature highlights and generous clean whitespace, modern layout, uncluttered, no watermark. Vertical 2:3 composition.

pdd-poster.name: PDD 促销海报
pdd-poster.desc: 大标题促销海报；需用 --text 传入主标题/促销语
pdd-poster.prompt_prefix: Bold promotional e-commerce poster for an online store.
pdd-poster.prompt_suffix: A big, eye-catching Chinese headline prominently displayed, correct spelling, strong color contrast, the product as the hero in the center, dynamic decorative shapes, retail sale atmosphere. No typos, no watermark. Square 1:1 composition.
